usedFor: Advogalia holds a law office's cases, clients and deadlines, and Slack is where the team talks. A “New Deadline” in Advogalia can run “Send Message” in Slack so the right people see a hearing or task.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deadline” in Advogalia, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Deadlines and hearings are the items a team cannot miss. “Send Message” can post to a channel, a user or a thread, and it can schedule the message.

watchOut: “New Deadline” is polling, so Slack hears about it on a schedule. An automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for approval today.
